reconstructed_statements: The model is defined over site_family, edge_family, and configuration_family.
The range of local_value_at is the set {-1, 1}.
local_value_at is indexed by configuration_family and site_family.
The regular degree of site_family in edge_family is 2.
The endpoint structure of edge_family is defined by edge_left and edge_right mapping to site_family.
The range of J is the real_domain.
The range of h is the real_domain.
The range of beta is the real_domain.

The energy of a configuration is the sum of the negated coupling term (J multiplied by the sum over all edges of the product of local values at the endpoints) and the negated magnetic field term (h multiplied by the sum over all sites of the local values).
The weight of a configuration is the exponential of the negative product of beta and the energy of the configuration.
The partition function is the sum of the weights of all configurations in configuration_family.
The probability of a configuration is its weight divided by the partition function.
formula_trees: \?1 (equal (energy ?1) (real_add (real_negate (real_multiply J (finite_fold real_add edge_family \?2 (real_multiply (local_value_at ?1 (edge_left ?2)) (local_value_at ?1 (edge_right ?2))) 0))) (real_negate (real_multiply h (finite_fold real_add site_family \?3 (local_value_at ?1 ?3) 0)))))
